{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Fine-gauge merino sweater, fitted with a high rolled neck and long sleeves, hip length, emerald green #0F6B4F, soft wool

Pleated midi skirt, A-line with a smooth waist, falling below the knee to mid-calf, deep burgundy #6B1E3A, fluid satin-finish crepe

Long wrap coat, straight cut with a softly structured shoulder and a tied belt, mid-calf length, camel #C19A6B, wool-cashmere blend

Ankle boots, almond toe with a stable block heel of medium height, black #1C1A1D, smooth leather

Silk scarf, square, worn loosely at the neck or draped over the head, in emerald, burgundy and gold, #0F6B4F, #6B1E3A, #C9A24B, twill silk

Statement earrings, sculptural drops, antique gold #B8923F, brushed metal

Structured top-handle bag, compact box shape, black #1C1A1D, grained leather

Why it works: The emerald and burgundy pairing is a rich, unexpected color combination that makes you stand out, yet it stays within the quiet, modest look a church service calls for, with covered shoulders, long sleeves and a below-the-knee skirt. These deep jewel tones flatter your fair, cool-toned skin and dark hair, and the emerald picks up the cool blue-grey of your eyes. The camel coat keeps the autumn chill away and carries you smoothly from the service to lunch with your parents, while the block-heel boots stay comfortable and polished. The silk scarf and gold earrings add the finishing interest, and the scarf can cover your head if the church asks for it."}
